jobs.name: stone-house
jobs.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one high-end editorial architectural/product photograph for the MySpice website, not a collage. The two input images are product identity references, not scenes to reproduce. Show the SAME MySpice appliance installed credibly in a different luxury kitchen. Preserve its wide rectangular proportions, softly radiused satin silver housing, thin charcoal lid, black bottom collector entirely underneath the housing, clear slender vertical spice reservoirs, recessed closed front recipe-support panel with a tiny circular button and narrow silver lip. No phone, no tablet, no paper: holder CLOSED and flush. Match the reference form faithfully, with realistic installation/contact shadows. Approximate real size 66 cm wide, 36 cm tall, 8 cm deep; it is a compact wall appliance, not a giant cabinet. Spices should be very fine real ground spices and tiny herb fragments, with subdued earthy color and restrained fill variation; never gigantic peppercorns, candy colors, repetitive plastic grains or neon yellow. Photorealistic fine materials, convincing metal/glass reflections, no CGI sheen, no halo, no heavy HDR, no oversharpening. Sophisticated photographic tonality, subtle grain and quiet natural imperfection, like a luxury architecture magazine. No text, logos, ratings, stars, brand signage, watermarks or borders. Every setting is fictional; do not depict a recognizable actual restaurant or imply an endorsement. Scene: an architect-designed warm limestone and pale oak residential kitchen, monolithic ivory stone backsplash and long honed travertine worktop, flush oak cabinetry, refined brushed-nickel fittings. MySpice mounted on the stone above a prep counter, about one third of the composition's width, fully visible and sharp. One ceramic bowl and a folded natural linen towel, very restrained styling. Wide horizontal 16:9 photograph, three-quarter architectural viewpoint at countertop height, room context visible, appliance integrated naturally. Soft morning window light from the side, neutral warm whites, realistic stone pores and faint tool marks. Inviting, calm and desirable, without excessive beige staging.
